quotes.speaker: Jordan McLaughlin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan McLaughlin on the Spurs' ongoing learning process
quotes.excerpt: Yeah, we're just learning. We're continuing to learn how to handle games. Each game is going to present something different.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Speaking of that winning streak, what things about it have stuck out to you that you've noticed that you guys are doing really, really well?

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan McLaughlin
text_blocks.text: Yeah, we're just learning. We're continuing to learn how to handle games. Each game is going to present something different. And for us to keep learning and growing, finding what's working for us every single game and finding out how to win as well down the stretch of games when they're close. So we're still learning and growing, but the process is right and the vibes are high.

quotes.social_post: Jordan McLaughlin on the Spurs growth: We are continuing to learn how to handle games. Each game is going to present something different. We are still learning and growing but the process is right and the vibes are high.

structured.context: Jordan McLaughlin reflects on the San Antonio Spurs' ongoing process of learning how to win close games.

quotes.speaker: Jordan McLaughlin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan McLaughlin on mentoring the young Spurs guards
quotes.excerpt: It's great, man. They keep you young. They're coming with a lot of energy every single day.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Speaking of how young this group is, especially those guards that you're kind of mentoring, what's it like being a 30-year-old around those rambunctious kids?

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan McLaughlin
text_blocks.text: It's great, man. They keep you young. They're coming with a lot of energy every single day. Obviously, Stephon Castle comes in with a lot of vibes and Dylan and everybody. Everybody just feeds off of each other.

quotes.social_post: Jordan McLaughlin on mentoring the young Spurs guards: It is great. They keep you young. They are coming with a lot of energy every single day and everybody just feeds off of each other.

structured.context: Jordan McLaughlin discusses his experience mentoring the younger players on the Spurs roster.

quotes.excerpt: No, not as talented as this.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: But as a group, have you ever been around a group as talented as this?

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan McLaughlin
text_blocks.text: No, not as talented as this. Fox, you know they all bring something different. They're all able to affect the games in their own way. And the way they do it every single night is pretty special to watch. So happy to be a part of it.

quotes.speaker: Jordan McLaughlin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan McLaughlin on his trade to the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: Yeah, I remember very, very well.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Do you remember getting the news that you're getting traded here? Do you have a vivid memory of that?

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan McLaughlin
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I remember very, very well. We were in Minnesota and Fox were in Minnesota on the end of a 14-day road trip and then we joined the team on a rodeo road trip. So I was away from my family for about 21 days and my son was born like 10 days just before that.

quotes.social_post: Jordan McLaughlin reflects on his trade to the Spurs: I was away from my family for about 21 days and my son was born just 10 days before that.

structured.context: Jordan McLaughlin recalls the circumstances surrounding his trade from the Minnesota Timberwolves to the San Antonio Spurs.
